import json,glob,re,os
hits=0
for path in sorted(glob.glob("9b3105a2-*/subagents/agent-aconv-*.jsonl"))+sorted(glob.glob("9b3105a2-*/subagents/agent-abatch*.jsonl")):
    with open(path,encoding="utf-8",errors="replace") as f:
        for i,l in enumerate(f,1):
            if "WindowModel" not in l: continue
            if not re.search("桩|stub|本地定义|唯一定义|arkts-immersive", l): continue
            r=json.loads(l); m=r.get("message") or {}; c=m.get("content")
            if isinstance(c,str): c=[{"type":"text","text":c}]
            for b in (c or []):
                if not isinstance(b,dict): continue
                txt=""
                if b.get("type")=="text": txt=b["text"]
                elif b.get("type")=="tool_result":
                    t=b.get("content"); txt=t if isinstance(t,str) else " ".join(str(x.get("text","")) for x in t if isinstance(x,dict))
                for mm in re.finditer("WindowModel",txt):
                    s=max(0,mm.start()-500);e=min(len(txt),mm.end()+400)
                    seg=txt[s:e]
                    if re.search("桩|stub|唯一|immersive|Layer",seg):
                        print(os.path.basename(path),"L%d"%i,r.get("timestamp"),r.get("type"))
                        print("   ...",seg.replace("\n"," / "),"...")
                        hits+=1
                        break
                if hits>7: break
            if hits>7: break
    if hits>7: break
